capabilities: Read and annotate PDFs with categorized highlights and links to exact pages and selections
Capture structured document metadata in custom fields beside the PDF
Manage a sortable, filterable PDF document register with bulk registration
Import EML/MSG email as PDFs with attachments and duplicate detection
Import ZIP archives transactionally with verification and rollback
extras: Pre-release software with an explicit warning to back up the vault before installing; desktop-only (Windows 11 best tested); the document register builds on Obsidian Bases with a custom view.
motivation: The author built it for document collections where users need to know where information came from, preserve the original source, add structured information, and find documents months or years later.
problem: Obsidian PDF tools typically stop at reading and highlighting, with no structured metadata, document registers, or traceability back to the original source.
summary: PDF source library that reads and annotates PDFs, stores structured document metadata in Markdown/YAML, and imports email and ZIP archives.
